steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: The tracks end here. Up ahead is...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Hah, I don't think we need to go any further.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What happened here?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: This village is the closest to where the miners abandoned their vehicles. I thought we might be able to ask around...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Hard to tell if anyone's still alive. The burn marks on the fence look recent.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: We're one step too late... again!
Amiya keeps walking, until the quiet ruins are plain in view.

The fire has long gone out. The bare branches in the surrounding woods cannot even hide the twin moons. The ruins are a sickly black in the pale moonlight, a far cry from what she imagined the village would look like.
Amiya feels a brief daze, then worry, as memories of a similar scene flash back into her mind.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mantra, we—

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I'll take a team and search for survivors.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll go too.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: We'll be fine, and we'll be back soon.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, let's go together and split up over there.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I think I see someone...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hello! We're a rescue team! We're here to help!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Do you live in this village? What happened here—

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Govno! Govno!

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Again!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I did say we were a rescue team, didn't I? Was my Ursine weird?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, he's just... afraid. I can sense it.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: He must live around this place, though, if he showed up here.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Should we follow him?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's not. We don't want to frighten them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Who's there?

steps.name: Young Infected
steps.text: Oh!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Careful—

steps.name: Young Infected
steps.text: I-I'm sorry!

steps.name: Young Infected
steps.text: I wasn't, following you, on purpose!

steps.name: Young Infected
steps.text: Your clothes, they're like hers, so...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Our clothes? Do you mean this symbol?

steps.name: Young Infected
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What's the name of this woman you're talking about?

steps.name: Young Infected
steps.text: S-Serafina...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Raidian's real name.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Is this Serafina a short Liberi with four arms?

steps.name: Young Infected
steps.text: You... know her?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes! She's our friend, and we've been looking for her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What's your name? Can you take us to Serafina?

steps.name: Young Infected
steps.text: I'm... Vetochki.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Follow me.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: A fire, broke out. The others are, outside the village.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Serafina was, helping us. Without her, we couldn't have, gotten here.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You're miners from the Central Mining District?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Yes. You're here, and you say you'll help. Thank goodness...

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Now, we can live—

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Here we are. Just ahead!

steps.name: Haggard Miner
steps.text: Who's there...?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Dyadya Volya? You still, have a fever... don't sit, at the door!

steps.name: Haggard Miner
steps.text: I'm fine. No fever. The wound on my leg doesn't hurt anymore when I tie it up with clothes.

steps.name: Haggard Miner
steps.text: And who are these people?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: They know, Serafina...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We come from the same pharmaceutical company. We've come to help—

steps.name: Surprised Voice
steps.text: Amiya?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Amiya... it's really you!

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: How did you find this place?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's really you...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We finally found you!
She runs up to her colleague and gives her a big hug.
Perhaps she should not be showing her emotions in front of others like this, but she cannot decline the opportunity to let her guard down.
Nothing beats the joy of reunion, and the comfort in seeing someone whom you have been worried about for a while.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I wasn't sure when the girl said your name, but now—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm so glad.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is everything alright, Raidian?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I'm fine. Sorry for making you worried.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Team Raidian, all nine members accounted for.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank goodness...

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: How did you find this place? Did someone find the markings I left behind?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: A wise course of action.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Mantra! I knew you would be with them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Doctor, Mon3tr, and I came when we lost contact with you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Doctor is with a researcher that we found, waiting for her to wake up. We'll meet up once communications are restored.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: The Doctor is here in Ursus too?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I think we all have a lot of questions to ask each other...

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: ...Rankin left with part of the group after the fire was put out.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: The ones here were unwilling or unable to follow, or villagers who lived here to begin with.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I regret not being able to stop the events...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So that's what happened...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is this Rankin linked to Reunion?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: No... as far as I can tell, he never made direct contact with Reunion. He simply believed there was a Reunion position on the Ursus-Kazimierz border.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I've heard fugitive Infected in the Far North talking about it. Does Rhodes Island have any intel?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Young Voice
steps.text: You mean these people have nothing to do with Reunion? They're just flying a banner that they happened to come across?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Who might you be?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Eloysius Gorchekova, Sergeant of the Imperial Guard, Vanguard Battalion. You can call me Eloysius.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: What is the Imperial Guard doing here?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Eloysius came to investigate rumors of mutated Infected in the Central Mining District. She helped us get into the district.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: It's a pleasure to meet you, Gospozha Raidian.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I am happy for your reunion, but time is short and I'll cut straight to the chase.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Were there any mutated Infected in this group of fugitive miners?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Mutated?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I'm sure you understand what I mean, as an operator of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: No... at least not the ones who stayed. We did not find any so-called mutated Infected when we examined them.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: That's strange... there's certainly something abnormal about these people. If there's nothing out of the ordinary with the ones who stayed, then we must hurry to catch up with the ones who left.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Did they tell you how they planned to proceed to the border? Or any other clues they left behind?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I don't think I'm obliged to report anything to you.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I assure you that my sole purpose here is to discover the truth about the mutated Infected and bring about order.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Deity Grypherburg seeks to protect the interests of the Infected.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I'm afraid I'm not convinced.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: At the Tashkent Mines, at Chorna Prison... I never saw a single noble who stood up for the interests of the Infected.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Ah... so you're Ursine too? Third Army, I take it?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: That was a long time ago.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Very well... I accept that you have legitimate reasons for your dim opinion of this nation.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Regardless, I am loyal to the motherland, and what you're trying to avoid lines up with what I'm trying to avoid, to an extent.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: The miners who left are headed towards the south. They will inevitably pass through Grypherburg on their way to the Kazimierzian border.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Whether they realize it or not, whatever their actual intentions are, they'll be treated as insurgents attempting to attack the capital, once they are discovered.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Only one end awaits them, in that event.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I thought you were going to ask a question, not make a threat.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I'm just stating the truth. I would not have to be so solemn if Gospozha Raidian here would be frank and honest with me. I need to know how these miners left, and why they fled.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Hiding the truth won't do you or them any good.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I see only a group of Infected who are only trying to survive. No one is in any position to denounce them.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You just won't listen, would you?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Gospozha Amiya, we've traveled together for a while now. Could you perhaps help me persuade our strong-minded Liberi here?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There's something even more urgent before that, Eloysius.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The miners and villagers here are in a dangerous situation. They have no supplies and nowhere to go. We can't just abandon them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We must ensure their safety before talking about the next step.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You don't have to worry about the villagers. I was planning to seek assistance from the Grand Duchess for the rebuilding of their village anyway. Her Imperial Highness has always been generous on such matters.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: These miners, though... they're not a problem that a letter will solve.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If you cannot offer assistance to them, then Rhodes Island will.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Very well, I'll help you one more time, for the sake of our cooperation.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: We take the miners to Grypherburg.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Yes. We go to Deity Grypherburg and report to His Imperial Majesty the truth about the Infected mutation in the Central Mining District, turning these miners into witnesses.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: This will give Grypherburg a reason to protect them, and intercept rather than eliminate the ones who left, until the investigation into the Grand Duchess has concluded, at least.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: And after that?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I'll persuade the Chairman to request that His Imperial Majesty grant amnesty to these Infected, then ask Rhodes Island to intervene on the grounds of medical assistance.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Or maybe you only need these miners for now, and you'll have no further use of them after you bring the Grand Duchess down.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Otherwise, you have no reason to spare these Infected. I know Ursus. Whatever warmth the Tsar wants to bring to this cold soil... the Infected will never be part of it.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Take that back.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I'm just stating the truth.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: How dare you—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: —Maybe that's true for Ursus, but I've seen enough of Eloysius that I'm willing to trust her.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sorry, Eloysius. Raidian's simply expressing her concerns. I'm sure we all know how Ursus has historically approached the Infected problem.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Very well... thank you for your trust, even if it's only towards me.
The Guardswoman bows at them exaggeratedly, and casts one last provoking look at Raidian.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: ...I have one final question.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Are you authorized to do this, Sergeant?

spans.text: Are you authorized to do this,

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Maybe you've been away from Grypherburg too long to know the weight that the name Gorchekova carries there.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: On the name of my house—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You don't need to worry about anything else, other than providing medical assistance.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: ...You're telling the truth.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Of course I am.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even if the plan works, we must get the miners to agree first.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Yes. I'll go.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I'll explain the situation to them and ask what they think.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: There you are, Vetochki...

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: There's something that we need to tell everyone. We have a choice: leave here and go to Deity Grypherburg together—

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Grypherburg?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Mama said, black locusts, and cherry trees, grow on the streets, of Grypherburg.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: The sky, is bright, the fowlbeasts, build nests, they don't, fly away.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: ...There's spring there. That, Grypherburg?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Yes, that Grypherburg. Do you want to go?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Yes! I wanna—

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: *cough*!
She is so eager that she lets cold air get into her throat, causing pain from the dryness.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I know you do. But what about the others?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I've never, left the mines. I...

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: We have to ask the others whether they're like you, if they're willing to trust us and go to Grypherburg.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I-I'll ask. I know, they will!

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Before you... came back, Darya said, we can't, get away.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Even if we, wanted to, go back, people outside would, stop us. They'll... burn us, to death.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I'll tell her, it's not, like that.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: You're right. It's not like that.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Darya! Darya?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Darya! We'll go, to Deity Grypherburg! Serafina has, a way!

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: We'll all, go!

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: ...Darya?
The girl is sitting straight with her back against the wall. Her eyes are closed, exhaustion upon her young face like shadows.
She still breaths, but she is not doing any more than the minimum required to live.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: No... we can't... stay here...

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Come with me—hang on, I'll carry, you!

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Darya...!

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Probably just tired. Let her rest, we'll find others—
Vetochki looks around, hoping that her friend's silence is just a coincidence.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Dyadya Volya...
She walks over and shakes them one by one, only to find that their backs are all straight and stiff, just like Darya.
Some are kneeling while others are standing, but they are all facing the old woman with bowed heads inside the house, as though they can hear nothing else.
Vetochki looks up, and a word slips from her mouth.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: ...Babushka?
Raidian follows Vetochki's fearful gaze.
An ancient voice fills the space in the direction that they are all looking.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: Welcome...

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: The one who Ursus remembers.
The figure's face and eyes are concealed by a hood, but somehow, Raidian has a feeling that the figure is not looking at her.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Sorry for the interruption, but you're taking too long.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Everyone! I have a proposal that can ensure your safety, to the greatest extent possible.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Sergeant—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Leave the Far North with us and come to Deity Grypherburg.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: The State Council will protect you, as long as you are willing to testify against the Grand Duchess.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: His Imperial Majesty must know what happened here. Ursus must know what happened here!

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Once everything is settled, Rhodes Island, where this lady you all know came from, will provide further treatment.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Now, anyone willing to come with me—

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: They're not listening.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: The electrical signals coming from them...
Suddenly, a strange coldness penetrates Raidian's cerebral cortex, virtually nailing her to the ground.
She is unwilling to offer any further warnings, even if she was just about to do so just a moment ago.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: What...?
Even the most chaotic electrical signal should have been benign to her, but now she turns it into a knife to keep herself lucid.
Raidian shuts out her sensations with Originium Arts, attempting to break the shapeless restraint.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: What are you—

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Argh—

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: We must—go!

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Take—everyone—leave!

a.text: 'Mantra... is this the name you go by now?'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mantra, I sense cold and... pain?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A vortex, inviting me to step inside...

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Amiya, do not look! Do not listen!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I—I—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ahh!

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Shut out your senses with Arts, Amiya.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Same for you, Elysium. Stay here while I find out what's happening.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mantra!

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Stay back! This is not normal. They can't hear us speak—

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Whatever it is...

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: It's calling to me.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: And I must face it.
Mantra closes her eyes, and begins to picture the closed space in her mind like a mental blueprint.
She steps into the house. She will find and anchor each active consciousness here, awaken them and make them 'hear'.
At least, that is what should have happened.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: There is only...

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Silence?
Red.
Piercing red.
Red, like the blood on the snow, encroaching upon the retina.
Then, she opens her eyes.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: Perseverance.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: Faith.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: Pain.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: The soul?

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: The soul.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: The soul!

a.text: <color=#FF4200>It is not our body that needs to be saved, but our souls.</color>
<color=#FF4200>Love and the soul are one and whole. Love makes us endure, makes us believe, makes us persevere.</color>
<color=#FF4200>And we shall meditate and share in the pain of others.</color>
<color=#FF4200>For you, for him, for all who endure pain...</color>
<color=#FF4200>Desire not your own life, decide not your own death.</color>

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: I endure.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: I believe!

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: I persevere...

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: Gosudar-batyushka—
